description: This file defines the AuthPage class for automating login-related interactions in a web application using Playwright. It includes methods for navigating to the login page, performing login with credentials, waiting for login success, and handling session cookies.

classes.name: AuthPage
classes.description: A class encapsulating login page interactions for automated testing with Playwright.

methods.name: goto
methods.description: Navigates to the login page URL.

methods.name: waitForLoginForm
methods.description: Waits until the login form is visible on the page.

methods.name: loginWithCredentials
methods.description: Fills in username and password fields and submits the login form.

methods.name: waitForLoginSuccess
methods.description: Waits for login to succeed by monitoring response and session cookie.

methods.name: getSessionCookie
methods.description: Retrieves the session cookie if present.

methods.name: hasLoginError
methods.description: Checks if the login form has validation errors.

methods.name: waitForLoginRequest
methods.description: Waits for the login POST request to be made and returns its response.
